cassiopeia.name: Queen Sector

cassiopeia.mythology: The legendary Queen of Ethiopia who boasted of her beauty.

cygnus.name: Swan Sector
cygnus.description: The graceful Swan beating its wings along the Milky Way.
cygnus.mythology: A symbol of fidelity, also known as the Northern Cross.

taurus.name: Bull Sector
taurus.description: The ancient Bull constellation, ablaze with the red fire of Aldebaran.
taurus.mythology: The sky's reflection of the white bull Zeus became when he carried off Europa.

gemini.name: Twins Sector
gemini.description: A symbol of brotherhood in the sky, with the twin stars Castor and Pollux.
gemini.mythology: Inseparable twins — one mortal, one divine.

aries.name: Ram Sector
aries.description: The ancient gate of the spring equinox and keeper of the Golden Fleece.
aries.mythology: The ram who bore the legendary Golden Fleece sought by Jason and the Argonauts.

cancer.name: Crab Sector
cancer.description: The simplest yet most mysterious corner of the sky, it hosts the Beehive Cluster.
cancer.mythology: The small but brave crab who battled Hercules.

leo.name: Lion Sector
leo.description: The king of the sky, crowned by the blue light of Regulus.
leo.mythology: The Nemean Lion — Hercules' first and hardest labor.

virgo.name: Maiden Sector
virgo.description: The goddess of fertility, shining with the star Spica, and home to galaxy clusters.
virgo.mythology: Herald of the harvest season, goddess of abundance and justice.

libra.name: Scales Sector
libra.description: The symbol of justice and balance in the sky.
libra.mythology: The scales of justice Astraea left behind when she abandoned the world.

scorpius.name: Scorpion Sector
scorpius.description: The sky's most dangerous hunter, beating with the red heart of Antares.
scorpius.mythology: The legendary scorpion that killed Orion — the two are never visible in the sky at the same time.

sagittarius.description: The archer who shoots an arrow at the center of the Milky Way. The gateway to the galactic core.
sagittarius.mythology: The sky's reflection of the wise centaur Chiron.

lyra.name: Lyre Sector

aquila.name: Eagle Sector
